prompt: Create a 2-column ×2-row transparent atlas for two distinct Race Circuits asphalt stairs. Row1 exact race-circuits-race-asphalt-stairs-up, row2 exact race-circuits-race-asphalt-stairs-down. Columns BOTTOM, REAR. The reference is a labeled source-plus-six contact per row; preserve each row's up/down orientation, red-white-black racing palette, hazard markings only where physically appropriate, and exact stair/side-support layout. BOTTOM is the underside looking upward: opaque, continuous structural slab or brace covering the full staircase footprint, no upper treads visible through solid support, same plan width/depth as that row's existing TOP. Do not draw a generic tray or foreign wood panel. REAR is the opposite horizontal camera elevation: show the back/support wall or closed riser backing of the stair flight with same common Z and broad stair length; NO exposed upper tread planes, no duplicate front view, no camera roll. Each cell is a separate complete orthographic projection for its corresponding row and column, centered in transparent gutter, no clipping, no text or grid. Use each source/current row as its own object identity authority; never swap UP and DOWN.

reference_inputs.role: each row binds actual source/current six and up/down identity
